// PURPOSE: Minimal dependency manifest for the AHM Hello World frontend.
// DEPENDENCY STRATEGY: This project uses a VENDORED dependency approach for runtime libraries.
Vue 3 and Vue Router are checked into source control under src/lib/ rather
than resolved through npm at build time. This ensures deterministic, offline-
capable builds — critical for embedding inside the Android WebView shell.
dependencies (vue, vue-router): Declared here for documentation purposes and
so that Vite can resolve bare-specifier imports like `import { ref } from 'vue'`.
In Vite mode, Vite's own resolver maps these to the vendored ESM bundles.
In SFC-loader mode, the importmap in index.html maps them instead.
and production builds. These are NOT shipped inside the Android APK.
- vite: The build tool that bundles .vue SFCs, CSS, and JS into a static
dist/ folder ready for deployment into android/assets/www/.
- @vitejs/plugin-vue: Vite plugin that teaches Vite how to compile .vue
Single-File Components (template + script + style in one file).
There is no lockfile (package-lock.json / yarn.lock) because runtime deps
are vendored, and dev deps are only used in development environments.
name: ahm-hello-world-frontend
